files.document_title: Maysville Expansion Project map, Columbia Gulf Transmission, January 2026
files.what_it_shows: The proposed route as a blue line from a point on the Ohio River north of Maysville, south through Mason and Fleming counties, to a point on the existing TC Energy line near Morehead in Rowan County, Kentucky.
Page 1 rendered at 150 dpi. Simplified road map with town dots, route shields and county shading, no scale bar.

searched: The oilandgaswatch record and its attached documents.
notes: The oilandgaswatch record page is a JavaScript application shell, so the URL checker cannot read it. The geometry comes from the site's data record, which was saved in fetched_layers/ogw. The oilandgaswatch geometry is graded Medium by that site.
